title: Make shared simple project construction the default for F# with evaluated opt-in
outcome: Use shared C#-like SimpleProjectModelBuilder for default F# navigation, retain EvaluatedProjectModelBuilder behind explicit evaluated mode, align binding confidence while preserving honest coverage, and remove default index-time advanced evaluation.
acceptance: Compiler binding confidence is consistent with the C# model; simple provenance alone does not force indexed, concrete omissions remain visible, and approximate counts never claim real-workspace completeness.
Default F# uses the shared simple builder; explicit PHOENIX_FSHARP_PROJECT_MODEL=evaluated retains the advanced evaluator, with no automatic fallback and unchanged C# input behavior.
F# authored source order, signatures, defaults and remove/re-include are tested; direct inputs and package handling are shared without repeated XML/source work for reference-only discovery.

Focused and complete gates, external MCP and website validation pass; full dual review resolves Critical/High via original reviewers. Version/schema/capabilities/docs reflect the changed default and persisted facts. No commit/push without fresh authorization.

Simple-mode cold/delta indexing does not run advanced Exists evaluation; switching to evaluated prepares fresh snapshot facts transactionally before use, including changes made while simple mode was active.
